verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a team-chat product, since alternatives like Zulip are self-hosted, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Slack offering a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of its core product. Its developer tooling (CLI, Bolt, Slack-hosted Deno workflows) concerns building apps against Slack's cloud, not running Slack yourself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
